Cautious.description: Objects to armed defense and pushing sick travelers at a grueling pace.

Bold.description: Gains trust when willing to stand and defend the party.

Steady.description: Ordinary trust losses are reduced by 25%; neither admires nor resents armed defense.

Nervous.description: Ordinary trust losses are 25% greater; strongly resents armed defense and pushing the sick.

Reckless.description: Strongly approves of a willing armed defense; does not object merely because a sick party travels hard.

Patient.description: Ordinary trust losses are reduced by 25%; mildly resents armed defense.

Stubborn.description: Ordinary disagreements hurt trust 25% more; mildly resents armed defense.

Adaptable.description: Accepts armed defense neutrally and gains a little trust when the party rests for someone sick.

Compassionate.description: Values care and rest for sick travelers; forbids robbery, murder and cannibalism.

Pragmatic.description: Accepts practical compromises but forbids murder. Expects a small wage premium.

Principled.description: Values keeping obligations; forbids robbery, murder, cannibalism and unpaid wages.

Self-serving.description: Accepts theft but forbids murder; appreciates personal care, without gaining trust from care for others.

Ruthless.description: Approves of robbery and has no default forbidden crime. Still reacts to unpaid personal wages and low trust.

Communal.description: Values care for others and resting for the sick; forbids robbery, murder and cannibalism.

Pacifist.description: Values care; refuses armed defense, robbery and murder. Accepting human remains is a separate boundary.

Opportunistic.description: Approves of robbery but forbids murder; values practical success more than helping strangers.

Loyal.description: Sticks with you: will not leave or refuse to help until trust falls 10 points lower than usual, and never betrays the party. Trust losses are normal. +10 cents/day if hired.

Mercenary.description: Requires an agreed cash wage plus party food. Honored payments can build trust.

Veteran.description: A fit, willing companion reduces confrontation injury risk by 3 percentage points, subject to its floor.

Cannibal.description: Has no personal objection to eating human remains. Does not grant approval of murder or deception.

Hardy.description: Personal health losses from all causes are reduced by 20%, rounded up; +10 cents/day if hired.

Quick Healer.description: Personal positive health gains increase by 50%, rounded down; +10 cents/day if hired. Recovery timers unchanged.

Iron Stomach.description: Personal health losses from food shortage are reduced by 25%; +5 cents/day if hired.

Sure-footed.description: Personal river-crossing injury damage is reduced by 25%; +5 cents/day if hired.

Cool-headed.description: Personal confrontation injury damage is reduced by 25%; +10 cents/day if hired.

Weatherwise.description: Personal exposure damage is reduced by 25%; does not replace warm clothing. +5 cents/day if hired.

Tireless.description: Personal exhaustion damage is reduced by 25%; +10 cents/day if hired.

Stoic.description: Takes hardship in stride: trust lost to rest days, pushing the sick, stopping for the sick and armed defense is halved. Moral choices and wages count in full. +5 cents/day if hired.

Field Medic.description: Provides the existing Caregiving party benefit even with another background; does not stack. +15 cents/day if hired.

Wagonwright.description: Provides the existing Carpentry party benefit even with another background; does not stack. +15 cents/day if hired.

Sharpshooter.description: Provides the existing Hunting reload benefit and a hunter's steadier aim in fights even with another background; does not stack. +15 cents/day if hired.

Haggler.description: Provides the existing Trading purchase discount even with another background; does not stack. +10 cents/day if hired.

Leatherworker.description: Legacy cross-training retained for saved travelers. New characters select the Leatherworking background instead. Unlocks leatherwork; +15 cents/day to market wage quote.

Frail.description: Takes 25% more health damage from all causes, rounded up.

Slow Healer.description: Health gains are halved, rounded down (minimum 1). Illness recovery timers are unchanged.

Sickly.description: Takes 50% more daily damage from an active illness; injuries and recovery timers are unchanged.

Cold-sensitive.description: Takes 50% more exposure damage when inadequately clothed.

Delicate Stomach.description: Takes 50% more health damage from food shortage.

Poor Endurance.description: Takes 50% more exhaustion damage from hard travel.

Clumsy.description: Takes 50% more personal injury damage from river crossings.

Shaken by Gunfire.description: Takes 50% more damage when personally injured in an armed confrontation.

Hot-tempered.description: Ordinary trust losses are 50% greater. Forbidden-action penalties remain bounded.

Distrustful.description: Trust gains are halved, rounded to half points.

Proud.description: Gains no trust from arranging care for them personally; can still appreciate care for others according to values.

Restless.description: Loses 1 trust on each rest day, including rest taken for illness. This can coexist with approval of caring for the sick.

fellow_traveler.description: A fellow traveler with no special prior attachment.

friend.description: Established friendship; stronger attachment to the leader.

family.description: A close relative; greater attachment is not permission to cross their boundaries.

stranger.description: An unfamiliar traveler; trust starts lower.

partner.description: A spouse or partner with strong trust and commitment.

sibling.description: A brother or sister with strong prior attachment.

cousin.description: A relative with some prior familiarity and attachment.

parent.description: An adult companion who is the leader's parent.

adult_child.description: An adult companion who is the leader's child.

mentor.description: An experienced acquaintance who knows you well.

former_employer.description: Someone from a former working relationship; this does not itself create a wage contract.

rival.description: An existing rival; starts with little trust, but may come to respect your decisions.
